name: ZOO or OOF🎯
desc:
ZOO or OOF! 🦓 
The animals are on the loose… 
Play as a sneaky animal escaping the zoo, or as the zookeeper trying to catch them!

🌟 Remember to like the game and join our group for the latest updates!

🐾 Animals: HIDE!
🔍 Zookeeper: SEEK!
🎯 Outsmart your opponent and win!

Will it be a clean escape or a big OOF?

🧸 Don’t worry! The weapons are fake, and the animals are just dummies, it’s all harmless fun.

DISCLAIMER: EARNINGS DISABLED IN PRIVATE SERVERS!
